claims.text: Extremely heavy rainfall is forecast over Coastal Andhra Pradesh on October 27 and 28, Odisha and Telangana on October 28, and Chhattisgarh on October 28 and 29, 2026.
A depression over the Bay of Bengal intensified into a deep depression at 11:30 a.m. on October 25, 2026, centered about 870 km east-southeast of Visakhapatnam.

The cyclonic system is forecast to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam as a very severe cyclonic storm by the forenoon of October 28, 2026, with maximum sustained wind speeds of 115-125 kmph gusting to 140 kmph.
Two cardamom plantation workers were killed in Mankulam, Idukki, after a tree fell on them due to heavy weather.
Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu ordered a high alert and prepared 10 NDRF and 11 SDRF teams for evacuation and relief operations.
The Odisha government cancelled leaves for district collectors, district magistrates, and critical officers in response to the approaching storm.
Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi ordered all schools, colleges, and Anganwadi centres closed in Ganjam, Gajapati, Rayagada, Koraput, and Malkangiri districts on October 28 and 29.
The Odisha state government deployed or placed on high alert 60 ODRAF teams, 17 NDRF teams, and 225 Fire Services teams ahead of the cyclone.
Cyclone warning signals were hoisted at nine ports including Chennai, Nagapattinam, Cuddalore, Karaikal, Pamban, and Thoothukudi.
Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi stated that the state government's primary objective regarding the cyclone is ensuring zero casualties.
Andhra Pradesh Central Power Distribution Corporation Limited cancelled employee leaves and established district control rooms to handle cyclone damage.
District administrations in Visakhapatnam, Anakapalli, and Alluri Sitharama Raju set up 24-hour control rooms and prepped relief centres in anticipation of severe weather.
The Bharatiya Janata Party announced nationwide protests for October 26, 2026, against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge over remarks directed at Prime Minister Narendra Modi's late father.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge tore apart all norms of decorum with his comment in Patna.
During an event in Patna marking the 139th birth anniversary of Bihar's first chief minister Shri Krishna Sinha, an audience member shouted 'Modi nahin jayega' at Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge.
Responding to a heckler in Patna, Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge said 'Modi ka baap bhi jayega'.
Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge called ongoing opposition protests against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls the second war for independence.
Union Home Minister Amit Shah claimed that repeated electoral losses over the past 12 years have driven the Congress party to desperation and the politics of slander.
The BJP released a statement accusing the Congress party of using language associated with thugs and functioning like a mafia gang.
BJP leader Nitin Nabin criticized the opposition, stating that dragging departed family members into public speeches has become the standard political culture under Rahul Gandhi.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Reserve Bank of India's new data centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that IT is no longer merely a support function but a core function of the central bank.
The newly inaugurated RBI data centre in Bhubaneswar features Tier IV accreditation across four independent facilities.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi warned that modern wars are fought by attacking national economies, stressing the need to shield India's banking system from cyber terrorists.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that nearly 600 million Jan Dhan bank accounts have been opened in India.
According to PM Modi, 130 million individuals have become first-time entrepreneurs under the Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana.
Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that the new RBI data centre will host mission-critical systems including RTGS and NEFT payment rails.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi accused past Congress governments of practicing phone banking by giving bank loans based on phone recommendations.
The Reserve Bank of India's new facility in Bhubaneswar was constructed at a cost of 169 crore rupees and spans 18.55 acres at Info Valley-II in Jatni.
Approximately 2,100 police personnel were deployed to secure Bhubaneswar during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit.
